## THIS BATCH — task 2.1 live capture (2026-09-09)

Maintainer ran, against this change's own already-open PR (#895, csrinaldi/brain,
allow_auto_merge:false):
  gh pr merge 895 --auto --squash --repo csrinaldi/brain
Exit non-zero, stdout empty, stderr verbatim (one line):
  GraphQL: Auto merge is not allowed for this repository (enablePullRequestAutoMerge)

Finding: the pre-capture placeholder assumed a HYPHENATED string ("auto-merge is not
allowed for this repository"). The real GraphQL text uses a SPACE ("Auto merge is not
allowed") plus a trailing "(enablePullRequestAutoMerge)" mutation-name parenthetical.

Sequence (STRICT TDD, RED confirmed before fix):
1. Fixture flipped derived:true -> recorded:true with verbatim stderr + captured_at/
   captured_by/command/repo/pr provenance fields.
2. Removed `{ todo: ... }` from the github unsupported contract test; kept the
   `fixture._provenance.recorded === true` gate assertion (correction 3's guard).
3. Ran focused suite — RED exactly as predicted: `reason:'transport'` actual vs
   `'unsupported'` expected (old regex's hyphen didn't match the real space).
4. Fixed GITHUB_MR_AUTO_MERGE_UNSUPPORTED_RE in providers/github.mjs to
   `/auto[- ]?merge is not allowed/i`.
5. Re-ran focused + full npm test — GREEN.

Scope decision: deferred the optional "squash merging is not allowed" classification
(same forge-refusal class, --squash is hardcoded) — no live/derived evidence for that
exact string exists yet; adding it would mean inventing a fixture string (violates D2)
or expanding scope beyond this work unit. Noted as a candidate follow-up, not started.
